displayAddress: Apartment 1005, 7 Symphony Park, Manchester, Greater Manchester, M1
description:
LUXURY CITY LIVING, REDEFINED
Experience a new way of renting at uhaus - a design-led residential community in the heart of Manchester. Combining beautifully crafted apartments with exceptional amenities, flexible workspaces and a vibrant resident community, uhaus offers a lifestyle designed around modern city living.

Perfectly positioned in Manchester city centre, uhaus brings together contemporary homes, premium amenities and a thriving social atmosphere, creating a place where residents can live, work and connect.

THE APARTMENT
This spacious two-bedroom apartment has been thoughtfully designed to maximise comfort and flexibility. The open-plan kitchen, dining and living area creates a welcoming space for entertaining, working from home or relaxing after a busy day.
Both bedrooms offer generous proportions with space for king-sized beds and ample storage. Selected layouts include en-suite bathrooms, while premium finishes and contemporary furnishings feature throughout.

A HOME THAT OFFERS MORE
Included Resident Facilities:

+ 24-hour concierge service
+ Resident gym and fitness studio
+ Private dining rooms
+ Bookable workspaces and meeting rooms
+ Resident lounges and breakout areas
+ Rooftop terraces and landscaped outdoor spaces
+ Pet-friendly community
+ Unlimited tea and coffee
+ Curated resident events and experiences

WORK, CONNECT AND SOCIALISE
uhaus combines premium residential living with dedicated coworking facilities, giving residents the flexibility to work, create and collaborate without leaving home.

Workspace Features:

+ Superfast WiFi
+ Phone booths
+ Meeting rooms
+ Breakout spaces
+ Desktop monitors
+ Printing facilities
+ Complimentary tea and coffee

A THRIVING RESIDENT COMMUNITY
Life at uhaus extends far beyond your apartment. Residents enjoy a calendar of exclusive events and experiences including wellness sessions, networking socials, live music, comedy nights and supper clubs.
Join in as much or as little as you like - it's your home, your community and your choice.

IN THE HEART OF MANCHESTER
Located in Manchester's vibrant M1 postcode, uhaus places you moments from the city's best restaurants, bars, shopping destinations and cultural hotspots.
Symphony Park provides green space directly on your doorstep, while St Peter's Square, Deansgate, Oxford Road and Manchester Piccadilly are all within easy reach.
At uhaus, you'll enjoy the energy of city-centre living alongside the comfort, convenience and service of a truly modern home.

VIEWINGS AVAILABLE
In-person and virtual viewings are available by appointment. Discover why more people are choosing a smarter, more connected way to rent at uhaus.
